label: FP
reason: The XSS findings are false positives. Both 'user' and 'rememberMe.getName()' do not receive user-controlled input. 'user' is constructed from hardcoded "SafeBystander" plus a substring of the class name (fully deterministic). 'rememberMe.getName()' returns the cookie name which is also generated deterministically from the class name. User input only affects 'param' which is stored in 'bar', but the conditional expression (500/42)+196=208>200 always evaluates true, meaning 'param' (parameter name, not value) is used instead of user values.

evidence.note: user variable construction from SafeBystander + class name substring, no user input
